title: Update on Roll-out of On-Board Units for ERP 2.0 System
what_it_is: Update on Roll-out of On-Board Units for ERP 2.0 System

sections.label: ERP 2.0 OBU installation progress
sections.summary: More than 217,000 vehicles had ERP 2.0 On-Board Units fitted as of 31 December 2024, with installation on track to finish by 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: As of 31 December 2024, more than 217,000 vehicles have been fitted with the Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) 2.0 On-Board Units (OBU).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We are on track to complete the installation by 2026.

sections.label: OBU features and alerts
sections.summary: The OBU shows School Zones, Silver Zones, bus lanes, speed cameras, travel times, car park availability and road closures, with more features being developed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to the OBU features, which are available on the OBU screen itself, as well as through the handphone or it can be pushed to the handphone, currently, we have features to indicate School Zones, Silver Zones, bus lanes and, of course, Traffic Police speed cameras.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have enhanced that so that it is not just indicating the fixed speed cameras, but also the mobile speed cameras and the red-light speed cameras.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Then, we also have travel time along expressways, car park availability.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: It is no more just in the city area, but you can also get car park availability in Buona Vista and Jurong.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Also, information on road closures for major events, like the National Day Parade or Purple Parade, for instance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And then we are looking at developing other features and among them would be, for instance, reminder of missed ERP payments that you can pay via the OBU and dynamic road traffic messages, like if there is a traffic accident.
